header.name: ModeStateChangeHistoryFlow
header.description: Validates and inserts a record of state and mode changes into the approrate history table.

data.transform:
(
  $wu := workunit.edges.node;
  $mode := $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.modeId;
  $coalesce([$mode,$wu.currentModeId]) = "Production" ?
  $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.stateId in $wu.productionStateList.stateListStates.edges.node.stateId
  :
  $wu.currentModeId = "Changeover" ?
  $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.stateId in $wu.changeoverStateList.stateListStates.edges.node.stateId
  :
  $wu.currentModeId = "Maintenance" ?
  $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.stateId in $wu.maintenanceStateList.stateListStates.edges.node.stateId
  :
  $wu.currentModeId = "Idle" ?
  $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.stateId in $wu.idleStateList.stateListStates.edges.node.stateId
  :
  $wu.currentModeId = "Disabled" ?
  $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.stateId in $wu.disabledStateList.stateListStates.edges.node.stateId
)
